def count_ones(n, i, ones):
    # Use as many i ones as possible
    times = i * (n // ones[i])
    n = n % ones[i]
    
    # If the number was complete
    if n == 0:
        return times
    
    # Decide whether to use one more of i ones to subtract or not
    return times + min(i + count_ones(ones[i] - n, i - 1, ones), count_ones(n, i - 1, ones))

def main():
    ones = [0] * 20
    for i in range(1, 17):
        ones[i] = ones[i - 1] * 10 + 1

    n = int(input())
    result = count_ones(n, 16, ones)
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
